name: opencode-anyrouter-cc
description: OpenCode V1 AnyRouter Claude Code gateway provider

scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm && bun -e "const file = Bun.file('dist/index.js'); await Bun.write('dist/index.js', (await file.text()).replace(/ +$/gm, ''))" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
